# Kitchen shell: a cream counter with lilac cabinet fronts, a mint stove block in the middle with
# three dark knobs, a back wall of 0.4 m tiles in two pastel blues (faces of a grid picked by a
# generated expression: no texture), a cream shelf. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Counter --base-color 1.0000 0.9020 0.7765 --no-slot
material new Cabinet --base-color 0.6902 0.6627 0.8941 --no-slot
material new Stove --base-color 0.6902 0.9216 0.5765 --no-slot
material new StoveFront --base-color 0.5294 0.6588 0.5373 --no-slot
material new Knob --base-color 0.4235 0.3373 0.4431 --no-slot
material new TileA --base-color 0.6745 0.8000 0.8941 --no-slot
material new TileB --base-color 0.7020 0.8902 0.8549 --no-slot
material new Shelf --base-color 1.0000 0.9020 0.7765 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name CounterL --size 1 --location -2.4 -0.075 -0.95
scale 1.6 1.35 1.9
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name CounterR --size 1 --location 2.4 -0.075 -0.95
scale 1.6 1.35 1.9
apply --scale
select CounterL CounterR
material assign Counter
material new Door --base-color 0.6745 0.8000 0.8941 --no-slot
material new Oven --base-color 0.4235 0.3373 0.4431 --no-slot
select CounterL
active CounterL
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
material assign Cabinet
inset 0.14
material assign Door
mode object
select CounterR
active CounterR
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
material assign Cabinet
inset 0.14
material assign Door
mode object
add mesh cube --name StoveBox --size 1 --location 0 -0.075 -0.95
scale 3.2 1.35 1.9
apply --scale
material assign Stove
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
material assign StoveFront
mode object
# hidden faces still bake: the bottoms, the backs against the wall, the sides where boxes touch
select CounterL
active CounterL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9 || normal.x > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select CounterR
active CounterR
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9 || normal.x < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select StoveBox
active StoveBox
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9 || abs(normal.x) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
# the oven door: a dark window on the stove front, under the knobs
add mesh cube --name OvenWin --size 1 --location 0 -0.76 -1.0
scale 2.0 0.04 0.7
apply --scale
material assign Oven
add mesh cube --name OvenBar --size 1 --location 0 -0.8 -0.55
scale 1.6 0.08 0.08
apply --scale
material assign Shelf
add mesh cube --name PullL --size 1 --location -2.4 -0.8 -0.3
scale 0.5 0.08 0.08
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name PullR --size 1 --location 2.4 -0.8 -0.3
scale 0.5 0.08 0.08
apply --scale
select PullL PullR
material assign Knob
add mesh cylinder --name K0 --vertices 8 --radius 0.11 --depth 0.1 --location -1.0 -0.78 -0.3 --rotation 90 0 0
add mesh cylinder --name K1 --vertices 8 --radius 0.11 --depth 0.1 --location 0 -0.78 -0.3 --rotation 90 0 0
add mesh cylinder --name K2 --vertices 8 --radius 0.11 --depth 0.1 --location 1.0 -0.78 -0.3 --rotation 90 0 0
select K0 K1 K2
active K0
join
rename K0 Knobs
material assign Knob
add mesh grid --name Wall --x-subdivisions 16 --y-subdivisions 6 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 6.4 2.4 1
apply --scale
translate 0 1.2 0
apply --location
material assign TileA
mode edit

set rotation 90 0 0

apply --location
add mesh cube --name ShelfBoard --size 1 --location 0 0.45 1.55

apply --scale
material assign Shelf
select all
shade flat
export kitchen.glb
